name: web/flask-api
title: Flask JSON API
summary: Flask JSON API with SQLite, input validation and tests.
when: Use when the project needs a small JSON API with a database and no ORM.

name.about: The service name, used in the README title and the health response.

resource.about: The collection name, used for the SQLite table and the route paths (a valid identifier, plural).

next: Write the files, create a virtual environment and install requirements.txt, run pytest, then replace the sample fields and resource name with the project's own data.
